# Fieldguide icons and glyphs · 0.31.8

Original inline SVGs now identify the four guide steps, independent career library, 12 career families, nine lifestyle categories, and individual lifestyle choices. The desktop Start illustration links home, creative work, health, and trades around a compass.

Icons sit beside readable labels and are hidden from assistive technology. They use no external font, image request, or new dependency. Phone card spacing remains compact. Category colors identify subjects; match colors retain their red-to-green meaning. All spending levels within a lifestyle category use the same accent. Selected cards retain a distinct border and background.

Question wording, matching, saved answers, financial calculations, and account behavior are unchanged. The gallery is available from Developer → Icons & glyphs.

Verification: 35 relevant regression tests passed, including student rendering across questions, all careers, plans, salaries, and lifestyle choices. Browser review covers mobile Start and lifestyle choices, desktop illustration, and the career library; this is presentation review, not assessment calibration.
